characterList.description: Middle-aged, bald man with a goatee, wearing a dark blue police uniform with medals and the name tag 'MICHAEL O'NEIL.' He is the little brother.
characterList.name: Michael O'Neil

characterList.description: Older, bald man with a close-shaved head, wearing a green paramedic uniform with the name tag 'PAUL.' He is the big brother.
characterList.name: Paul O'Neil

characterList.description: Middle-aged, bald man with a clean-shaven head, wearing a dark blue police uniform with the name tag 'TONY O'NEIL.' He is the middle brother.
characterList.name: Tony O'Neil

content_metadata.description: An overview of the O'Neil brothers—Michael, Paul, and Tony—and their collective dedication to serving the Queensland community through various branches of emergency services.

qAndA.answer: Michael O'Neil has the most medals on his police uniform.

qAndA.answer: Paul is the oldest, followed by Tony, and then Michael.
qAndA.question: What is the age order of the three brothers?

qAndA.answer: The mood begins lighthearted and humorous but transitions to a more reflective and proud tone as the brothers discuss their combined service and career fulfillment.
